items.title: US Stocks Slide as AI Selloff and Nvidia Jitters Deepen
items.summary: United States equities experienced a downturn as investors reacted to a broad selloff in artificial intelligence firms. Nvidia shares took a significant hit, compounded by market anxiety surrounding the resignation of company leader Jensen Huang. This pullback ahead of crucial corporate earnings weighed heavily on major Wall Street indices like the Nasdaq, which recorded losses exceeding one percent.
items.why: Major US tech bellwethers often dictate global sentiment, and sudden leadership changes or sector corrections can trigger cross-border capital shifts.

items.title: SEBI Establishes Sub-Group to Review IPO and Fundraising Norms
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has formed a specialized sub-group within its Primary Market Advisory Committee. Led by NSE chief Chauhan, the panel's primary objective is to reassess current regulations concerning initial public offerings and corporate fundraising. The initiative aims to streamline compliance procedures, eliminate redundant requirements, and facilitate smoother market access for eligible issuers.
items.why: Regulatory reviews of primary market rules directly affect how companies list shares and how easily retail and institutional investors can participate.

items.title: Blackstone Trust Acquires Majority Stake in Amazon Data Centers
items.summary: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust has officially committed to purchasing a 75.1 percent stake in joint ventures alongside Amazon Web Services. This major transaction highlights continued large-scale capital deployment into digital infrastructure assets. The agreement underscores the massive financial valuations attributed to modern cloud computing and data storage facilities globally.
items.why: Large institutional investments in digital infrastructure reflect long-term structural demand trends across the global technology landscape.

items.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO Opens with Modest Grey Market Premium
items.summary: Crystal Crop Protection has scheduled its initial public offering to open for subscription from November 18 to November 20, 2026. Ahead of the bidding process, unofficial grey market tracking indicated a small premium of thirteen rupees per share. This points toward an estimated low single-digit listing gain for prospective investors based on current sentiment.
items.why: Monitoring grey market trends helps new participants gauge immediate secondary market demand prior to an official stock exchange listing.

items.title: Silver ETFs Crash as Global Demand Forecasts Decline
items.summary: Silver exchange-traded funds experienced sharp declines of up to five percent following projections that global demand for the white metal will drop by five percent throughout 2026. Gold ETFs also witnessed downward movement alongside the broader precious metals selloff. This correction aligns with a stronger US dollar and shifting macroeconomic conditions impacting commodity valuations.
items.why: Precious metal ETFs track physical commodity prices and global industrial demand, making them sensitive to shifts in macroeconomic forecasts.

items.title: Indian Rupee Emerges as Asia's Top Currency on FPI Inflows
items.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened to become the best-performing currency across Asia, bolstered by substantial foreign portfolio investor inflows into domestic equities. These robust capital injections helped blunt broader global economic headwinds and reduced currency volatility. Analysts note that sustained foreign buying has provided vital stability to the local foreign exchange market.
items.why: Strong foreign capital inflows increase demand for the local currency, helping insulate the domestic economy from external global shocks.

items.title: Wall Street Futures Edge Lower Ahead of Fed Policy and Nvidia Earnings
items.summary: US stock index futures traded lower as market participants braced for key corporate earnings reports and updates on central bank policy. Major benchmarks, including the Dow Jones and S&P 500 futures, faced downward pressure amid ongoing developments in the artificial intelligence sector. Investors remained cautious while awaiting clarity on upcoming interest rate trajectories from Federal Reserve officials.
items.why: Wall Street sentiment sets the tone for overnight global market cues, heavily influencing opening trends in Asian equity markets the following day.

items.title: India Wholesale Inflation Accelerates to Double Digits in October
items.summary: India's wholesale price inflation surged to 12.3 percent in October, marking the second consecutive month of double-digit increases. The acceleration was primarily driven by sharp upward spikes in fuel, power, and crude oil costs across domestic markets. This persistent inflationary pressure raises important considerations for central bank monetary policy and future borrowing costs.
items.why: Wholesale inflation tracks price pressures at the producer level, serving as an early indicator of retail price trends and potential monetary tightening.
